hypothesis.claim: At the prospectively frozen 2,331,505 Endpoint428 HORIZON-A coordinates, an integer-quantized causal KT continuation expert combined with the exact unchanged Endpoint428 pretruth probability by one global Q63 Bayesian mixture saves at least 40,163,160 truth-path bits, is positive in every chronological third, and beats shifted, random, and negated experts under the identical endpoint.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire HORIZON-A as a target-closing Endpoint428 specialist if its integer-mixture gain is below 40,163,160 bits, is nonpositive in any chronological third, or does not beat every matched control both globally and in every third.

changedMechanism: Observe the exact Endpoint428 pretruth 16-bit probability at every frozen HORIZON-A active bit, convert the already frozen byte-level KT donor law into prefix-conditional integer probabilities, and evaluate one global parent-versus-specialist Q63 Bayesian mixture without writing parent state or changing the encoded archive.
invariants: The source population is exactly the 647,798,592-byte Endpoint428 WRT stream already certified by the parent census; A coordinates and D/S/R/N donors are regenerated byte-identically from the frozen source transition.
The parent trace has exactly 5,182,388,736 pretruth rows, magic CMX21P1\0, one little-endian uint16 probability per WRT truth bit, and no zero probability.

The trace-enabled Endpoint428 executable and observer were previously shown archive-identical to the retained parent on the exact opening-10M population; this gate changes no coded probability and grants no archive authority.

At each active byte, D, S, R, and N use separate causal KT correct/incorrect counts reset only at the two fixed chronological-third boundaries; each byte distribution is converted to eight prefix-conditional probabilities before observing the truth byte.

The integer mixture starts with equal Q63 parent and specialist mass, persists globally across active bits, sleeps without update outside A-active bytes, rounds deterministically to the nearest parent probability count, clamps only to [1,65535], and updates after each truth bit.
Parent probability, candidate probability, mixture state, KT counts, and all controls are computed before the current truth updates any state.
No source address, distance, length, donor, probability, or route is transmitted; all manifest and trace files are zero-credit observation artifacts only.
Separate source, parent, mixture, and control gains are never added to an archive forecast; a pass authorizes exactly one native P/K/D finite-coder implementation.
